concepts.def: Many firms, homogeneous product, perfect information, free entry/exit; firms are price takers.
Price equals marginal cost (P = MC); consumer welfare maximised; achieved in perfect competition long-run.
Producing at the lowest point on average cost curve; firms in perfect competition long-run achieve this.
Just enough revenue to cover all costs including opportunity cost of capital; long-run equilibrium in perfect competition.
Profit above normal; in perfect competition only in the short run; entry erodes it.
Price below average variable cost; firm closes in the short run to limit losses to fixed costs.
